title: [ingest] Measure commands time out at 120s so a runaway can't hang the daemon
summary: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 120000 bounds every inline metric-spec measure command (execSync timeout). A measure command that hangs is killed rather than wedging the daemon.
